View all News Others Scientific Writing and Reporting Scientific Writing and Reporting View all search results Our Faculty Home Faculty Ramaguru Radhakrishnan Ramaguru Radhakrishnan Convener — Institution's Innovation Council (IIC), Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Coimbatore | Assistant Professor (Sr. Gd.), TIFAC-CORE in Cyber Security, School of Engineering, Coimbatore Qualification: M.Tech (Cyber Security), B.Tech (IT) r_ramaguru@cb.amrita.edu Orcid Profile Google Scholar Profile Scopus Author ID Research Interest: Formal Methods, Blockchain Security, Cryptocurrency Forensics, Cyber Psychology, VAPT, System Testing and Cyber Crime Investigation Bio Publications Education Experience Teaching Research Honors Responsibilities Outreach Projects Guided Bio Ramaguru Radhakrishnan currently serves as Assistant Professor (Senior Grade) at TIFAC-CORE in Cyber Security, Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Coimbatore. He is presently pursuing his doctoral research on a Formal Methods Framework for Verifying Semantic Security and Incentive Robustness in Smart Contracts. His research focuses on developing verifiable and secure smart contract systems using formal methods and language-based techniques, with the goal of improving the reliability, correctness, and security of decentralized applications. Prior to his academic career, he gained over five years of industry experience as a System Test and Test Automation Engineer, having worked with leading automotive companies such as Robert Bosch and Harman International. During this time, he contributed to several infotainment system projects for global clients including Jaguar Land Rover (JLR), Suzuki, Nissan, and Renault, where he specialized in system testing, software quality assurance, and end-to-end automation frameworks. His academic and research interests span formal methods, blockchain security, smart contract verification, automotive cyber security, and software testing. He is passionate about mentoring students for hackathons, ICPC competitions, and collaborative research projects, encouraging hands-on learning and innovation.
